section_summary.extract_value: This Results section describes a single study examining self-compassion as a moderator of the relationships between body comparison/appearance self-worth and body appreciation. Data from 257 participants (after outlier exclusion) combined from MTurk and college samples were analyzed using regression-based moderation analyses. The findings show that self-compassion significantly moderates both the body comparison-body appreciation relationship and the appearance self-worth-body appreciation relationship, with stronger negative associations at low levels of self-compassion.
